env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

mkdir go lgo
cp go.mod.txt go/go.mod
cp go.mod.txt lgo/go.mod
cp main.txt go/main.go
cp main.txt lgo/main.lgo

cd go
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
logos run .
stderr '^all 256 token values passed$'
go run .
stderr '^all 256 token values passed$'

replace 't >= tokenCount' 't > tokenCount' main.go
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr -count=1 '"rule_id":"correctness::array_index_out_of_bounds"'
! logos run .
stderr 'panic: runtime error: index out of range \[2\] with length 2'
! go run .
stderr 'panic: runtime error: index out of range \[2\] with length 2'

cd ../lgo
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
logos run .
stderr '^all 256 token values passed$'

replace 't >= tokenCount' 't > tokenCount' main.lgo
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr -count=1 '"rule_id":"correctness::array_index_out_of_bounds"'
replace 'func (t token) String() string {' '//logos:allow(correctness::array_index_out_of_bounds)\nfunc (t token) String() string {' main.lgo
! logos run .
stderr 'panic: runtime error: index out of range \[2\] with length 2'

-- go.mod.txt --
module example.com/guardedenum

go 1.27

-- main.txt --
package main

type token uint8

const (
	tokenLight token = iota
	tokenDark
	tokenCount
)

func (t token) String() string {
	names := [...]string{"light", "dark"}
	if t >= tokenCount {
		return "unknown"
	}
	return names[t]
}

func main() {
	for value := range 256 {
		want := "unknown"
		switch value {
		case 0:
			want = "light"
		case 1:
			want = "dark"
		}
		if token(value).String() != want {
			panic("incorrect enum string")
		}
	}
	println("all 256 token values passed")
}
